decisions.scenario: Finding a two-star hotel in the north with free parking

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I am looking for a hotel on the north side.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are several options in the north, all in the cheap to moderate price range. Do you have any other requirements?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I would like a two-star hotel with free parking.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Ashley Hotel and Lovell Lodge both match those requirements.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Ashley Hotel sounds fine. Could you book it for me and give me the postcode?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The postcode is CB4 1ER. What day would you like the reservation for?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Actually, I do not need a booking. Thanks. Have a nice day.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You are very welcome. Thanks for contacting the Cambridge TownInfo Centre, and have a great day!

decisions.scenario: Booking a four-star east-side place to stay with free parking

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Can you find me a place to stay on the east side with free parking?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are five hotels and one guesthouse on the east side with free parking. Do you have a price range in mind?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I would like a four-star place. I do not mind the price.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are five four-star guesthouses: Allenbell, Autumn House, and Leverton House are cheap, while Carolina B&B and Warkworth House are moderate. Do you have a preference?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Let us try Allenbell. Could you reserve it for one person for five nights starting Wednesday?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: No problem. Your reference number is GWQNWQXD. Is there anything else?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: No, that is all I needed today. Thank you for your assistance!

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Enjoy your stay. Goodbye!

decisions.scenario: Finding a moderately priced guesthouse in the east with free parking

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are no hotels matching those requirements, but there are three moderately priced guesthouses in the east. Would you like more information?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Sure. Do any of them have free parking?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Yes. Carolina B&B and Warkworth House both have free parking.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Could you give me the address and postcode for Warkworth House, please?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Certainly. It is on Warkworth Terrace, postcode CB1 1EE.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thank you. That will be all.

turns.speaker: Assistant

decisions.scenario: Getting information about El Shaddai before deciding whether to book

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I need to make a reservation at a hotel called El Shaddai.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Sure. What day would you like to start your stay at El Shaddai, at 41 Warkworth Street?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Could you tell me what area it is in, the price range, and whether it has internet?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: It is in the centre, it is cheap, and it offers internet access.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Great. I would like to book that hotel, please.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: What day would you like to start your stay?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Actually, I think I will make my own arrangements. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Is there anything else I can do for you today?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That is all. Thank you so much.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: All right. Please contact us again if you need anything else.
